record.bible_text: And in that day<WH03117> thou shalt say<WH0559><WTH8804>, O LORD<WH03068>, I will praise<WH03034><WTH8686> thee: though thou wast angry<WH0599><WTH8804> with me, thine anger<WH0639> is turned away<WH07725><WTH8799>, and thou comfortedst<WH05162><WTH8762> me.
